tool_schemas.name: lol-champion-leader-board
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current champion-specific leaderboard for the given LoL region and champion, listing top players with champion performance summaries; results are returned as a single unpaged list for that region/champion snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if region or champion is not one of the supported enum values or is missing. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your token cannot access the product, NOT_FOUND if no leaderboard snapshot exists for that region/champion, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if you exceed request limits.

region.description: Regions in the game League of Legends.

champion.description: These are the champion names in the game League of Legends.

tool_schemas.name: lol-champion-analysis
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest champion analysis snapshot for the requested game_mode, champion, position, and lang, including rates (win/pick/ban where available) and recommended runes/items/skill orders for that segment; this endpoint does not paginate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required parameter is missing or not one of the supported enum values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your token cannot access the product, NOT_FOUND if we don’t have an analysis snapshot for the given mode/position/champion combination, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if you exceed request limits.

game_mode.description: Different queue types and game modes in League of Legends.

champion.description: These are the champion names in the game League of Legends.

position.description: These are the champion positions in the game League of Legends.

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: lol-champion-meta-data
tool_schemas.description: Returns localized meta statistics for the specified champion (lang-scoped), such as performance metrics used across OP.GG champion views; this endpoint returns a single record and does not paginate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if champion or lang is missing or not one of the supported enum values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your token cannot access the product, NOT_FOUND if the champion meta snapshot is unavailable for the requested language, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if you exceed request limits.

champion.description: These are the champion names in the game League of Legends.

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: lol-champion-skin-sale
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current list of champion skins on sale localized to the requested lang; results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lang is missing or not one of the supported enum values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your token cannot access the product, NOT_FOUND if no active sale catalog is available for the requested language, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if you exceed request limits.

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: lol-summoner-search
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the cached summoner profile for the provided Riot ID (game_name + tag_line) and returns identity, ranked summary, and recent match history (latest-first) from our cache; match lists are returned as a single unpaged block as stored for that profile. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if no summoner/profile cache exists for the provided Riot ID (including wrong region routing), and CONFLICT if a refresh/renewal job is already running for the same Riot ID. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your token cannot access the product, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if you exceed request limits, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE if upstream data required to serve/refresh the profile is temporarily unavailable.

game_name.description: The first part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Annie" in "Annie#Opgg").

tag_line.description: The second part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Opgg" in "Annie#Opgg").

region.description: The region to search in (e.g., KR, NA, EUW).

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: lol-champion-positions-data
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the analytics of champions by each positions. You can also look up the winrate, banrate, plays, wins, kills, kda and etc. `tier_data` is champion tier which tells which champion is powerful (OP) or not, for example `tier 1` champion is easy to play and powerful champion. (You can recommend this champion to the user if they want recommandation)

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

format.description: Format of the output data. Determines the format of returned data. Default is `csv`.

game_name.description: The first part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Annie" in "Annie#Opgg").

tag_line.description: The second part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Opgg" in "Annie#Opgg").

region.description: The region to search in (e.g., KR, NA, EUW).

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: lol-summoner-renewal
tool_schemas.description: Renew the summoner's data of OP.GG through RiotAPI. When you retrieve summoner data, you *must* always call this function first, and then call the next functions.

game_name.description: The first part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Annie" in "Annie#Opgg").

tag_line.description: The second part of a Riot ID (e.g., "Opgg" in "Annie#Opgg").

region.description: The region to search in (e.g., KR, NA, EUW).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def lol_summoner_renewal(game_name, tag_line, region, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0449000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0449000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    start = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    # ---- request logging / quota ----
    def _log(status, error=None, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
        row = {
            "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "service": "OP.GG",
            "endpoint": "lol-summoner-renewal",
            "timestamp": now,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "error": error,
            "meta": extra or {},
        }
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _enforce_limits():
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        # Renewal is heavier:
        # - rate: 30 / 60 seconds
        # - daily quota: 1000 / 24 hours
        t_now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
        def _parse(ts):
            try:
                if isinstance(ts, str) and ts.endswith("Z"):
                    return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts[:-1])
                if isinstance(ts, str):
                    return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
            except Exception:
                return None
            return None

        last_min = 0
        last_day = 0
        for r in logs:
            if r.get("endpoint") != "lol-summoner-renewal":
                continue
            ts = _parse(r.get("timestamp"))
            if not ts:
                continue
            dt = (t_now - ts).total_seconds()
            if 0 <= dt <= 60:
                last_min += 1
            if 0 <= dt <= 86400:
                last_day += 1
        if last_min >= 30:
            return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Too many renewal requests. Please try again later.", retry_after_seconds=60)
        if last_day >= 1000:
            return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily renewal quota exceeded.", reset_after_seconds=86400)
        return None

    lim_err = _enforce_limits()
    if lim_err:
        _log("error", error=lim_err["error"])
        return lim_err

    # ---- validation ----
    LOL_REGIONS = {"KR","BR","EUNE","EUW","LAN","LAS","NA","OCE","RU","TR","JP","PH","SG","TH","TW","VN","ME","SEA"}
    if not isinstance(game_name, str) or not game_name.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "game_name must be a non-empty string.")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(tag_line, str) or not tag_line.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tag_line must be a non-empty string.")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(region, str) or region not in LOL_REGIONS:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "region is invalid for LoL.", allowed=sorted(LOL_REGIONS))
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    def _norm_riot_id(gn, tl):
        gn2 = " ".join(gn.strip().split())
        tl2 = " ".join(tl.strip().split())
        return (gn2 + "#" + tl2).strip().lower()

    norm = _norm_riot_id(game_name, tag_line)

    # ---- load stores ----
    players = _load("players.json")
    if not isinstance(players, list):
        players = []
    matches = _load("player_matches.json")
    if not isinstance(matches, list):
        matches = []
    jobs = _load("renewal_jobs.json")
    if not isinstance(jobs, list):
        jobs = []

    # ---- insert renewal job (queued) ----
    job_id = "job_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    job = {
        "id": job_id,
        "product": "LOL",
        "region": region,
        "game_name": game_name,
        "tag_line": tag_line,
        "normalized_riot_id": norm,
        "player_id": None,
        "requested_by": None,
        "status": "queued",
        "attempt_count": 0,
        "last_error": None,
        "enqueued_at": now,
        "started_at": None,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    jobs.append(job)
    _save("renewal_jobs.json", jobs)

    # ---- dispatch/execute: move to running ----
    # Transition validation: queued -> running allowed
    job["status"] = "running"
    job["attempt_count"] = int(job.get("attempt_count") or 0) + 1
    job["started_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    _save("renewal_jobs.json", jobs)

    # ---- emulate upstream renewal: since offline, we "succeed" by refreshing timestamps and (if missing) create cached payloads ----
    # Upsert player
    player = None
    for p in players:
        if p.get("product") == "LOL" and p.get("region") == region and p.get("normalized_riot_id") == norm:
            player = p
            break

    if not player:
        player_id = "ply_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        player = {
            "id": player_id,
            "product": "LOL",
            "game_name": game_name,
            "tag_line": tag_line,
            "normalized_riot_id": norm,
            "region": region,
            "puuid": None,
            "profile_payload": None,
            "last_renewed_at": None,
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        players.append(player)
    else:
        player_id = player.get("id")
        # keep case-preserved latest
        player["game_name"] = game_name
        player["tag_line"] = tag_line
        # If it was disabled/not_found, renewal can reactivate (legal transitions allow not_found->active, disabled->active)
        if player.get("status") in ("not_found", "disabled"):
            player["status"] = "active"
        player["updated_at"] = now

    # Refresh profile payload (minimal deterministic structure)
    # Note: we do not fabricate external data; but renewal is explicitly an ingestion/refresh operation.
    # We store a simple payload indicating refresh time.
    player["profile_payload"] = {
        "riot_id": f"{game_name}#{tag_line}",
        "region": region,
        "refreshed_at": now,
        "source": "offline-cache",
    }
    player["last_renewed_at"] = now
    player["updated_at"] = now

    # Upsert recent matches for this player: ensure at least a few cached entries exist
    # Maintain uniqueness (player_id, external_match_id).
    existing_ids = set()
    for m in matches:
        if m.get("player_id") == player_id:
            existing_ids.add(m.get("external_match_id"))

    new_count = 0
    # Generate 5 recent matches if missing; otherwise touch ingested_at/updated_at for latest 5.
    # played_at must be <= ingested_at
    desired = 5
    # Touch existing most recent matches
    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s[:-1]) if s.endswith("Z") else datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None
    player_rows = [m for m in matches if m.get("player_id") == player_id and m.get("product") == "LOL"]
    player_rows.sort(key=lambda r: (_parse_dt(r.get("played_at")) or datetime.datetime.min), reverse=True)
    touched = 0
    for m in player_rows[:desired]:
        m["ingested_at"] = now
        m["updated_at"] = now
        if m.get("status") == "hidden":
            m["status"] = "active"
        touched += 1

    to_create = max(0, desired - touched)
    for i in range(to_create):
        ext = "LOL_MATCH_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]
        played_at = (now_dt - datetime.timedelta(hours=2 * (i + 1))).isoformat() + "Z"
        mrow = {
            "id": "mt_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "player_id": player_id,
            "product": "LOL",
            "region": region,
            "external_match_id": ext,
            "played_at": played_at,
            "queue_or_mode": "RANKED",
            "summary_payload": {
                "generated": True,
                "note": "Offline cache entry created during renewal.",
                "result": random.choice(["win", "loss"]),
            },
            "ingested_at": now,
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        # uniqueness check (should not collide)
        if ext in existing_ids:
            continue
        matches.append(mrow)
        existing_ids.add(ext)
        new_count += 1

    _save("players.json", players)
    _save("player_matches.json", matches)

    # ---- finalize job: running -> succeeded ----
    job["player_id"] = player_id
    job["status"] = "succeeded"
    job["finished_at"] = now
    job["updated_at"] = now
    _save("renewal_jobs.json", jobs)

    resp = {
        "job": {
            "id": job_id,
            "status": job["status"],
            "attempt_count": job["attempt_count"],
            "enqueued_at": job["enqueued_at"],
            "started_at": job["started_at"],
            "finished_at": job["finished_at"],
            "player_id": player_id,
        },
        "summoner": {
            "id": player_id,
            "product": "LOL",
            "region": region,
            "game_name": player.get("game_name"),
            "tag_line": player.get("tag_line"),
            "status": player.get("status"),
            "last_renewed_at": player.get("last_renewed_at"),
            "profile_payload": player.get("profile_payload"),
        },
        "meta": {
            "matches_touched_or_created": touched + new_count,
            "matches_created": new_count,
            "note": "Renewal populates/refreshes the cache. Call lol-summoner-game-history next.",
        }
    }
    _log("ok", extra={"job_id": job_id, "player_id": player_id, "matches_created": new_count})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: lol-brawl-champion-tier-rank
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves champion tier ranking list in brawl mode.

lang.description: Language code for localized content. Determines the language of returned data.

tool_schemas.name: esports-lol-schedules
tool_schemas.description: Get upcoming LoL match schedules.

region.description: Region scope used to select the latest applicable esports snapshot.

lang.description: Language code for localized content returned by the snapshot.

league.description: Esports league short name to filter schedules.

tool_schemas.name: esports-lol-team-standings
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current team standings table for the requested LoL league identified by shortName, including each team’s placement and record as stored in the latest esports snapshot for that league (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if shortName is missing or not one of the supported league keys; raises NOT_FOUND if we have no standings snapshot for that league. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when your client is rate-limited, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the credentials are missing or not permitted to access esports data.

tool_schemas.name: tft-meta-trend-deck-list
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest applicable TFT meta “trend deck” list for the given region scope and lang, localized using the requested language; the full deck list is returned as a single snapshot (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if region or lang is missing, not in the supported enums, or if extra parameters are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when no meta snapshot exists for that region/lang combination, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

region.description: Region scope used to select the latest applicable TFT meta snapshot.

lang.description: Language code for localized deck names/strings in the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: tft-meta-item-combinations
tool_schemas.description: Returns TFT item combination and recipe data for the requested language (or the service default when language is omitted), including base components and combined item outputs (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if language is provided but is not one of the supported locale codes. Raises NOT_FOUND if the item-catalog snapshot for that language is unavailable, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

language.description: These are the champion names in the game League of Legends.

tool_schemas.name: tft-champion-item-build
tool_schemas.description: Returns the recommended item build data for the specified TFT championId from the latest available TFT meta snapshot (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if championId is missing or not in the supported championId set. Raises NOT_FOUND if we do not have build data for that champion in the current snapshot, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

championId.description: TFT champion ID to retrieve item build for

tool_schemas.name: tft-recommend-champion-for-item
tool_schemas.description: Returns a ranked list of TFT champions that commonly or optimally use the specified itemId based on the latest available meta snapshot (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if itemId is missing or not in the supported itemId set. Raises NOT_FOUND if the item has no recommendation data in the current snapshot, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

itemId.description: TFT item ID to get champion recommendations for

tool_schemas.name: tft-play-style-comment
tool_schemas.description: Returns playstyle commentary derived from the cached TFT player profile for the given region and Riot puuid, summarizing champion tendencies and play patterns as we have them at request time (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if region is missing/unsupported or puuid is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the player is not present in cache for that region/puuid (or has no analyzable match data), QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

tool_schemas.name: valorant-meta-maps
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest Valorant map meta snapshot as stored by OP.GG, including per-map aggregated performance or usage metrics where available (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required query parameters (if any) are missing or not supported, or when unsupported extra parameters are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when no map meta snapshot is available for the requested scope, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when authentication is missing or not allowed.

region.description: Region scope used to select the latest applicable Valorant maps snapshot.

lang.description: Language code for localized map names/strings in the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: valorant-meta-characters
tool_schemas.description: Valorant character meta data

region.description: Region scope used to select the latest applicable Valorant characters snapshot.

lang.description: Language code for localized agent names/strings in the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: valorant-leaderboard
tool_schemas.description: Fetch Valorant leaderboard by region

tool_schemas.name: valorant-agents-composition-with-map
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve agent composition data for a Valorant map.

tool_schemas.name: valorant-characters-statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest aggregated Valorant agent (character) statistics, optionally scoped to a specific map when `mapId` is provided; the response contains the computed stats for each agent for the currently active snapshot and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `mapId` is present but not a valid Valorant map identifier. Raises NOT_FOUND if no statistics snapshot exists for the requested map scope, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the Valorant dataset.

tool_schemas.name: valorant-player-match-history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Valorant match history for the player identified by `gameName` and `tagLine`, ordered from most recent to oldest, using server pagination when the history is long (via the API’s standard page/cursor controls, when supported). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `gameName`/`tagLine` are missing, empty, or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the player cannot be resolved in the cache (or has no cached history), and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS/UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when request quotas or access controls prevent reading player data.

tool_schemas.name: game-catalog-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists game catalog entries (champions/items/maps/agents/leagues) filtered by game/entity_type/status and optionally by external_key; returns a paginated list ordered by updated_at desc. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED when the token cannot access the requested game.

game.description: Product/game namespace for the catalog entries.

entity_type.description: Type of catalog entity to list.

external_key.description: Exact external key to filter by (e.g., ANNIE, TFT14_APHELIOS, Ascent).

lang.description: Optional language hint for localized_names selection; does not change stored keys.

tool_schemas.name: game-catalog-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single game catalog entry by id. Returns the full row including localized_names/metadata and current lifecycle status. Raises NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED when the token cannot access the requested game.

id.description: Primary key of the catalog row.

tool_schemas.name: game-catalog-update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing game catalog row and/or performs a status transition (active<->deprecated). Returns the updated row. Refuses invalid transitions and raises VALIDATION_ERROR; raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks write access for the game.

id.description: Primary key of the catalog row to update.

localized_names.description: Localized names keyed by language tag (e.g., en_US, ko_KR).

metadata.description: Arbitrary catalog metadata payload; merged/replaced per vendor semantics.

status.description: Sets lifecycle status; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: meta-snapshots-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists meta snapshot headers filtered by game/snapshot_type and optional dimensions (region/lang/game_mode/position/etc.); returns paginated results ordered by effective_from desc then created_at desc. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid enums/dimensions, and UNAUTHORIZED when the token cannot access the requested product.

region.description: Region filter; validated per product (LOL/TFT LoL-style regions; VALORANT uses {AP,BR,EU,KR,LATAM,NA}).

champion_external_key.description: LoL champion external key dimension when applicable (e.g., ANNIE).

tft_champion_external_key.description: TFT champion external key dimension when applicable.

tft_item_external_key.description: TFT item external key dimension when applicable.

valorant_map_external_key.description: Valorant map external key dimension when applicable.

esports_league_short_name.description: Esports league short name dimension (e.g., LCK, LEC) when applicable.

effective_from_lte.description: Filter snapshots with effective_from <= this value.

effective_to_gte.description: Filter snapshots with effective_to >= this value (or null effective_to).

tool_schemas.name: renewal-jobs-create
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues an on-demand player renewal job for a Riot identity (game_name/tag_line) and region, creating a renewal_jobs row with status='queued' and dispatching execution. Returns the created job record; refuses invalid regions/products and raises VALIDATION_ERROR; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token cannot request renewals for the product.

product.description: Product whose player cache should be renewed.

region.description: Product-specific region; validated at request time.

game_name.description: Riot game name (name part of Riot ID).

tag_line.description: Riot tagline (tag part of Riot ID).

requested_by.description: Caller-provided identifier for auditing (e.g., your user id or service name).
